Title: Mask of 1000 Faces and Force of Will

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
How do these two cards interact?
Can a tapped vamp play Mask to pick up another vampire's Force of Will?
Can an untapped one?
Who takes the agg damage from the action?
Does the original vampire untap or just "not tap"?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
>
> How do these two cards interact?
> Can a tapped vamp play Mask to pick up another vampire's Force of Will?

No (card text on Mask).

> Can an untapped one?

No (card text on Force of Will).

(This is probably a reversal of a previous ruling I'd made without
paying close enough attention to the card text on FoW).
